Yes:

```gdscript
if OS.is_stdout_verbose():
    print("...")
```

However, consider that printing verbose statements is something that will be done often in more complex scripts. Having to add this `if` statement every time quickly becomes time-consuming after you've been doing it dozens of times, especially for print statements that you only leave around temporarily.

There is also `print_debug()` as an alternative, but this method prints a stack trace in debug builds, which makes it noisy. On top of that, it can't be temporarily disabled in debug builds.
